description: email.rs:807-823: thread-id generation uses OnceLock<u64> seeded from SystemTime and AtomicU64 counter. Caveats are documented. This is correct for the in-process MemoryBackend use case. Replacing with UUID would add a dependency; replacing with a random-per-call timestamp would have worse collision properties.
title: next_id() atomic-counter + clock-seed design is appropriate
